I remember this one time, I was at the grocery store and I saw this guy who looked eerily similar to one of my former coworkers. My heart started racing and I couldn't shake the feeling that he was following me. I ended up leaving the store without buying anything and just getting out of there as fast as I could. And then there are these little things, like my phone dying at the most inconvenient times or finding these weird bugs on my laptop. I know it's just paranoia, but what if it's not? What if they really are tracking me?
